mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.3 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which drives equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 102.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) signals broad-based demand strength, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPI inflation above 3.0% combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS >= 5.0%, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals a strong labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 158000.0, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts signals strong consumer demand and confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
